_comment: Cross-runtime vectors for usage-limit dialog detection. Read by BOTH src/__tests__/limit-notice.test.ts and android/.../AgentScreenLimitVectorsTest.kt, so the hand-authored Kotlin twin cannot drift from the TS source. Pane geometry follows a live capture: 58 columns, a titled top border once the session has a name, the composer prompt, a solid bottom border, then the toolbar. `expect` is null when nothing is detected, otherwise an object whose `detail` is the text after the headline's middle dot (null when the headline has no dot).
